properties.displayName: [Custom] Kubernetes cluster containers should not allow privilege escalation
properties.description: Custom OPA/Rego-backed Azure Policy definition. Wraps the open-source Gatekeeper library's K8sPSPAllowPrivilegeEscalationContainer constraint template (https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper-library/tree/master/library/pod-security-policy/allow-privilege-escalation) to block containers that omit securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false.

metadata.description: 'audit' allows a non-compliant resource to be created but flags it as non-compliant. 'deny' blocks the non-compliant resource from being created. 'disabled' turns off the policy.
Container images (exact match, or prefix match ending in '*') excluded from enforcement.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to include in policy evaluation. An empty list means all namespaces not explicitly excluded.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation.
